task: Open the base image /home/user/Documents/landscape_base.png (800x600 — sky blue on top, green ground on bottom) in GIMP. Open /home/user/Documents/logo_overlay.png (100x100 solid red) as a new layer on top of the base image and position it so its top-left corner sits at offset (20, 20) on the base canvas. Flatten the image into a single layer and export the result as a PNG file to /home/user/Documents/composite_final.png. The final image must still be 800x600 pixels.

verification.description: Pixel (70,70) inside pasted logo region is red
Pixel (500,100) in untouched sky area is sky blue
Pixel (500,500) in untouched ground area is green

cli_feasibility.translation: Use ImageMagick composite: composite -gravity northwest -geometry +20+20 overlay.png base.png output.png
cli_feasibility.reason: Layer compositing is possible but requires correct offset/alignment calculation
